g.text: Solid segments: quarters with any covered day (opacity = share of the quarter covered). Light dashed segments: the
sensitivity states' possible start range (earliest to latest quarter), coverage solid after it.
13 states had Medicaid coverage of Wegovy/Zepbound in 2026 Q1; 5 states' coverage had
ended or lapsed at some point
Source: warehouse coverage table (state Medicaid documents).
